newsitem.title: USA: Central Illinois to shut 325 MW power unit.
newsitem.headline: Central Illinois to shut 325 MW power unit.

text.p: Central Illinois Public Service Co said Wednesday it plans to shut down later today a 325 megawatt (MW) coal-fired power unit at its Coffeen generating station.
"We'll be taking down Coffeen unit 1 about 9 or 10 PM (2100-2200 CST) this evening to repair a boiler tube leak. We anticipate having it back up and running on Sunday," said a company spokesman.
The adjacent coal-fired, 560 MW unit 2 was running at full power, he said.
The power facility is on an artificial lake near the town of Coffeen, Montgomery County, in south-central Illinois.
Central Illinois Public Service Co is a subsidiary of CIPSCO Inc, based in Springfield, Ill.
